title: Temple reply
description: Structured output of the Monk's session (PS-12d, ADR 0027), passed to the CLI with its JSON Schema flag: one decision for each group of repeated failures of the evidence pack, at the lowest rung of the fix ladder (prevent, check, script, knowledge, scripture, model) that cures it, or none; and a review of each line the pack names worth one. The caller checks it against the pack and turns it into one temple_report command (source = monk).
$comment: Generated by `pnpm schemas` from the zod source in packages/domain/src/schema (ADR 0003): change the zod source, never this file. Not checked by this schema because they need the evidence pack: each group of the pack is decided once and none outside it; each source_verdict is a verdict of its group; at most TEMPLE_ADDS_MAX (3) lines and TEMPLE_LETTERS_MAX (6) letters; each review names a line of the pack's reviews, once (templeReplyIssues). Checked by zod, not stated here so the contract keeps to what every tribe's CLI takes: a decision carries a letter or a line, never both, and none for rung none.

group.description: The group of the pack: its fail kind.

why.description: Why this rung, in a sentence or two.

letter.description: rungs prevent, check, script: a proposal to the Chancellor; model: a word to the owner.

source_verdict.description: A fail verdict of the group: what the line or the letter comes from.

refs.description: Files the memo is about, relative to the plot, as the character wrote them ('/' separators).

lesson.description: knowledge: a line of the temple's scripture scoped to a territory; scripture: a line anywhere, new or merging lines of the Monk.

owner.description: Whose scripture: `temple` for the shared one, else a character's id.

scope.description: Where a lesson loads (PS-12): every key present must match the session, values of one key are alternatives. Absent, the lesson loads in every session. The CLI version is no filter but where the lesson was measured (cli_version, lesson-sharing S5).

role.description: The role of the session: assignee, verifier.

class.description: The character's class, a registry id.

tribe.description: The character's tribe, an id of kingdom.tribes[].

os.description: The OS the Steward runs on.

territory.description: The quest's territory: a scope that never leaves the kingdom (lesson-sharing S2, P3).

tag.description: At least one of these tags on the quest.

text.description: The sentence: one imperative line of at most 300 characters (lesson-sharing T4).

source_verdict.description: A fail verdict of the group: what the line or the letter comes from.

replaces.description: The Monk's lines this one merges (two or more): they go out as it comes in.

items.description: A line of the Monk the pack names worth a review: keep it, or retire it.

decisions.why: Three runs of knights stopped before the README the quest named; no check can tell which README a quest means.

lesson.text: Before you hand in, reread the quest's done-when and tick each item in your handover.

decisions.why: Every fail of this kind is on one territory, whose CLAUDE.md names the generated files.

lesson.text: Edit the zod source, never docs/schemas, then run pnpm schemas.

decisions.why: The judges flag the same lint rule each time: a check catches it before review.

letter.body: Add `pnpm lint` to the checks of territory elvaria for every *.ts path: three fails of kind style were lint errors a check would have caught.

decisions.why: Three fails, three different causes: not enough to choose a rung yet.

reviews.why: Loaded 24 times, helped 9 and missed 15: the tests_fail rate did not move.

decisions.why: Every fail is the same class on the same cheap model, and the checks already say what failed.

letter.body: Move class sage to a stronger model of its tribe: 6 of its last 8 runs failed tests_fail on gemini-3.8-flash-low.
